attributes.verification: Measured directly from build/GUNE5D/src/game/world/gauntworld.o against build/GUNE5D/obj/game/world/gauntworld.o. VERDICT: INELIGIBLE, and the reason is structural rather than a guard being conservative. The recolor path (copy_register_fields / verify_consistent_recolor) fails its first precondition, which demands equal word-aligned sizes. The permutation path (permute_instruction_atoms) fails its bijection check, because a permutation reorders the atoms that already exist and can never introduce the missing instruction. No audit hatch is appropriate: unproven_recolor_audit only bypasses the bisimulation, never the size and bijection preconditions, and using it here would be exactly the guard-weakening the tool contract forbids. The class therefore has no postprocessor route and remains closed pending the dead-local identity lever. Locked in by test_home_copy_coalescing_class_is_not_recolor_eligible, which asserts both refusals.
